title: Mai's English CV Challenge
segments: Mai scrolled through job listings on her new smartphone. Suddenly, an exciting opportunity caught her eye. It was her dream job! But the application clearly stated: 'English CV required.' A wave of panic washed over her. Her English writing wasn't strong, and using the small phone screen for such an important task felt impossible.

Then, Mai decided to try writing her English CV. She opened a document on her new smartphone. Typing on the small screen was difficult. Her fingers kept hitting the wrong keys. She also struggled with finding the correct English words for her work experience. "How do I say 'managed a team' professionally?" she wondered.

Because of this, Mai felt very stuck. She looked out her window and saw her neighbor, Mr. Lee, watering his plants. He was known for his excellent English. Hesitantly, Mai went to her door. "Excuse me, Mr. Lee," she began, "can you help me with my English CV and my new phone?"

After that, Mr. Lee smiled kindly and came inside. He sat with Mai and looked at her phone. He showed her how to use the keyboard's autocorrect feature for common words. Then, he explained professional English phrases like "managed a team" and "developed new strategies" for her CV. Mai felt much more confident.

Then, Mr. Lee helped Mai organize her skills and experiences clearly. They worked together, adding strong action verbs. Mai learned how to make her CV look professional. After a final check, she felt very proud. Her English CV was polished and ready. She thanked Mr. Lee sincerely for his amazing support.

After that, Mai confidently clicked 'submit' on her polished English CV. A wave of relief and pride washed over her. She thanked Mr. Lee again, feeling truly grateful for his kind help. She now felt ready for new challenges. Her new job felt closer than ever, thanks to her neighbor's support.
endWrap: Mai learned that asking for help and learning new skills can open many doors. Her journey showed the power of community and perseverance.

She opened a document on her new smartphone. Typing on the small screen was difficult. Her fingers kept hitting the wrong keys. She also struggled with finding the correct English words for her work experience. "How do I say 'managed a team' professionally?" she wondered. Because of this, Mai felt very stuck. She looked out her window and saw her neighbor, Mr. Lee, watering his plants. He was known for his excellent English. Hesitantly, Mai went to her door. "Excuse me, Mr. Lee," she began, "can you help me with my English CV and my new phone?" After that, Mr. Lee smiled kindly. "Of course, Mai! Come in, let's look at your CV together." He patiently explained common English phrases for work experience, like "managed a team." He also showed her how to use the phone's dictation feature, making typing much easier. Mai felt much more hopeful about her application. After that, Mai and Mr. Lee worked for an hour. Mr. Lee helped her choose the best words for her experience. He also showed her how to check her writing on the phone. Finally, Mai's English CV was perfect! She felt proud and thankful. She quickly sent her application. "Thank you, Mr. Lee!" she said. A few days later, Mai received an email. It was an invitation for a job interview! She quickly called Mr. Lee. "I got an interview, thanks to you!" she exclaimed. Mr. Lee smiled. Mai felt so proud of her English CV and her new phone skills. She knew she could face new challenges now, all thanks to her kind neighbor. Mai learned that with help and practice, new skills are possible. Her journey shows that even big challenges can be overcome with a little support.
